image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a rocky intertidal zone. The central subject is a dark, oval-shaped chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to the rock, displaying its characteristic eight dorsal plates. To the left and bottom are two sea stars (one orange, one purple/reddish) with textured, bumpy surfaces. The background consists of rough, wet rock with patches of pink coralline algae and small barnacles.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is reduced without eyes or tentacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The anterior end of the chiton is visible and blunt; there are no protruding eyes, stalks, or tentacles, consistent with chiton anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anterior end is blunt and indistinct.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front of the animal tapers slightly but remains blunt and lacks distinct head features, matching the description.
The surface appears uniform without any obvious sensory organs like antennae or eye spots.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dorsal surface protected by eight overlapping calcareous plates arranged in linear series.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eight distinct, light-colored plates are clearly visible running down the center of the dark body in a linear arrangement.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plates embedded in tough leathery girdle that may be smooth, spiny, or hairy.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates are surrounded by a dark, thick-looking mantle (girdle) that appears leathery and textured, holding the plates in place.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plate coloration ranges from grey, brown, green to mottled patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates are a creamy/beige color contrasting with the dark grey/black girdle, fitting the general coloration description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface features broad muscular foot for adhesion to rocky substrates.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a dorsal (top-down) perspective. The ventral side (foot) is pressed against the rock and completely occluded.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits dorsoventrally flattened profile when clinging to surfaces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal conforms tightly to the irregular surface of the rock, appearing flattened and low-profile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Can curl into defensive ball when dislodged.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral trait observable only if the animal is dislodged. In this static image, the animal is adhered to the rock, so this state cannot be verified.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomic identity of the central mollusk and distinguish it from other similar marine invertebrates.
To verify the structural integrity of the eight plates and their connection to the girdle, ensuring no AI-generated fusion or floating elements.
To assess the overall texture consistency of the rock, sea stars, and chiton, looking for subtle smoothing or noise artifacts common in AI generation.
To identify and segment the auxiliary subjects (sea stars) to ensure they don't interfere with the primary subject analysis and to check for anatomical correctness of limbs.

focus_areas: Integrity of the eight dorsal plates (count and overlap)
Texture distinction between the calcareous plates and the leathery girdle
Boundary sharpness between the chiton and the rocky substrate
Anatomical correctness of the adjacent sea stars (limb count/structure)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction between the plates and the girdle. AI often blurs this boundary or creates inconsistent textures. Verify that the plate count is exactly eight and that they follow the natural curvature of the body. Check if the sea stars exhibit any 'melting' into the rock or incorrect arm structures.
